notes: Case creation and initial ingestion run, not a fresh live-collection pass. The case operator supplied 19 docx files (with several exact duplicates) from an external ChatGPT Deep Research investigation conducted 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-16: 11 numbered Deep Research Snapshots plus one unnumbered first snapshot (Snapshot 7 was never supplied and is a known gap), a 763-question Continuing Investigation Question Bank, two Answer Registers (A-K and L-T, RUN 001, together classifying 519 questions RESOLVED/PARTIAL/OPEN), a GIPA Primary Record Acquisition Pack, and an AE Primary Record Acquisition Register. This run: (1) deduplicated the uploads by hash, (2) extracted text from each unique docx (including recovering hyperlink targets from the underlying OOXML relationships, since plain-text extraction alone loses citation URLs), (3) read the full corpus, and (4) promoted the highest-value confirmed facts, negative-search findings, RESOLVED answer-register items, and two messaging contradictions into this register - not a mechanical transcription of all 230 findings or 763 questions, which remain in the preserved source material for future runs to draw on (see DEC-0002). Nothing in this run was independently re-verified by fetching the underlying NSW Government/Police/media sources directly - every item is recorded at verification_state "Unverified" pending that work (see DEC-0001). See DEC-0003 for the case's data-layer architecture.

The case operator supplied Snapshot 7 (MAYHEM-MNC-POLAIR-REMOTE-DEEP-RESEARCH-SNAPSHOT-7-2026-08-16.docx, findings F-131-F-140, the policy-feedback/technology-ratchet branch), closing the gap noted at NOTE-0008/RUN-0001 - it had been referenced by Snapshot 8 as its exact predecessor but was never uploaded to this repository. Confirmed it is genuinely new (not a duplicate of any already-preserved file) before processing. Preserved it at preserved/snapshot-07-2026-08-16.txt. Promoted six new evidence items: continued PolAir-Remote operational use nearly seven months past its stated six-month window with no located extension notice (EV-0037); a second, separate procurement instrument, EOI YR-2026-0012 (Aviation Command Operating Model Review), published five weeks before the RPAS Panel EOI (EV-0038); precise dating showing the RPAS Panel EOI was published before the Moree consultation itself had closed (EV-0039); NSW Police leadership statements from the trial's own commencement and launch contemplating statewide scaling from day one (EV-0040); a reconfirmed negative finding that no RPAS panel award is publicly established (EV-0041); and a negative finding that no public stop, failure, or decommissioning criteria exist anywhere in the material checked (EV-0042). Added CHR-0020 (the 2 August 2026 incident underlying EV-0037) and two new open questions, Q-0017 (stop/decommissioning criteria) and Q-0018 (how EOI YR-2026-0012 relates to PolAir-Remote governance). Deliberately did NOT register a new contradiction for the 'assess first' (Police Minister, early June) vs 'prepare to scale' (EOI published 2 June) sequence Snapshot 7 itself flags, since the source document explicitly states these are not contradictory (the EOI is market research, not a purchase decision) - recorded as EV-0039's investigation_relevance instead. As with RUN-0001, every item here is verification_state "Unverified" pending independent confirmation (DEC-0001).

Full-corpus expansion run, prompted by direct operator feedback that the Evidence Register was too thin against the size of the source material. Systematically parsed and ingested all 230 numbered findings (F-001-F-230) from every preserved snapshot, not just a curated subset: F-001-F-043 (cumulative register in Snapshot 3, compact one-line format, cited to the snapshot's own end-of-document source list rather than per-item URLs), F-044-F-050 (Snapshot 4), F-051-F-090 (Snapshot 5), F-091-F-130 (Snapshot 6 - the only snapshot with real per-finding inline Source: URLs, which produced 29 new Source Register entries, SRC-0044 to SRC-0072), F-131-F-140 (Snapshot 7, already ingested at RUN-0002 and not re-added here), F-141-F-160 (Snapshot 8), F-161-F-180 (Snapshot 9), F-181-F-200 (Snapshot 10), F-201-F-210 (Snapshot 11), and F-211-F-230 (Snapshot 12, with some overlap against the RUN-0001 curated set - the same underlying fact appearing at two evidence IDs from two passes is treated as acceptable duplication, not an error, since both are independently traceable). Evidence items without a per-finding external URL cite their exact preserved snapshot file and finding number as source_location, which is honest about precision rather than fabricating a specific citation the source document itself didn't provide. All 262 items remain verification_state "Unverified" (DEC-0001) - this run mined the existing corpus far more completely, it did not perform any new independent verification. The 519-item Answer Register (RESOLVED/PARTIAL/OPEN classifications across all 763 question-bank items) remains a further, not-yet-mined layer - see DEC-0006.
